courses.text:
BIOL 2303 - General Genetics
Credits: 3 Class: 3 Lab: 0
Prerequisite(s): BIOL 1302/BIOL 1102,CHEM 1308/CHEM 1108, and credit or enrollment in BIOL 2103.
Fundamental principles of genetics including Mendelian inheritance, linkage, the chemical basis of genetics, mutations and chromosomal aberrations.

observedChoices: Choose one technical writing course from the five listed options.
Calculus I alternatives: MATH 2411 or MATH 2401.
Second mathematics/computing choice: MATH 2412 or CS 1408 or CS 1411. Do not silently substitute MATH 2402.
Physics I: PHYS 1307 + PHYS 1107 or PHYS 2401 + PHYS 2101. Physics II: PHYS 1308 + PHYS 1108 or PHYS 2402 + PHYS 2102. Verify individual course credits from records.
Seminar alternatives: BIOL 4311 or MBIO 4311 or SUST 4301.
High-impact requirement: one listed high-impact lab or any two listed CURE courses. BIOL 4399 carries the Honors Program enrollment marker.
Upper-level options: 23 hours, with at least one in each of four named content areas. Course/lab pairing and allocation need review.
Special Topics options marked if approved: MBIO 3390/4390 in Cell/Molecular and Environmental; BIOL 3390/4390 in Plant/Fungal and Organismal.
BIOL 4302 appears in Organismal with the source qualifier (if not used aboved); do not double-allocate it to both that area and high-impact lab.
Organismal list includes an explicit or between MBIO 3320 and MBIO 4340; preserve the original grouping until interpreted with MBIO 4140.
Undergraduate research is limited to 6 hours toward the degree; upper-level electives complete the 120-hour minimum.
